request.style: English, male baritone solo with warm choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, organ, hopeful and majestic mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We know our old self was crucified with him
The body of sin is rendered powerless now
No longer slaves to the weight of our sin
For anyone who died is set free somehow

[Chorus]
Christ has been raised from the dead
He will never die again
Death no longer has dominion over him
His life is pure and clean

[Verse]
If we died with him we believe we live
We will also live with him forever
The death he died was once for all
He lives to God in every way

[Chorus]
Christ has been raised from the dead
He will never die again
Death no longer has dominion over him
His life is pure and clean

[Bridge]
Consider yourselves dead to sin
But alive to God in Christ Jesus
Do not let sin reign in your body
Do not obey its empty wishes

[Outro]
He lives to God
Death has no dominion
